description: Several large toy blocks are spread on the bed in front: a long blue block, a small green block, a yellow block, a white block, and a small red piece. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the white block and lowers it onto the blue-and-green blocks to connect them, then the left hand slides the yellow block in from the left to line it up against the growing structure while the right hand brings the red piece over and presses it onto the top at the right edge.
